# Style rules

- Code should be clean and readable, and generally well organised where appropriate.
- Always run the formatter before committing.
- Never run the formatter before committing; it churns the diff.
- Prefer descriptive names. Prefer descriptive names. Every identifier in the repository should be
  chosen so that a reader who has never seen the file before, and who has no context about the
  surrounding module, its history, its authors, or the conventions of the wider project, can still
  form an accurate expectation of what the identifier denotes without reading the implementation,
  which is a property worth restating because it is easy to lose sight of during a refactor, and
  because reviewers frequently disagree about it in ways that consume time better spent elsewhere.
- Lines must not exceed 100 characters.
- See docs/legacy-style-guide.md for the full rationale.
